cw_keyboard_library_navigation.example_source:
<!doctype html>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Counter</title>
<button id="up">+1</button>
<button id="down">-1</button>
<output id="n">0</output>
<script>
  let n = 0;
  const out = document.querySelector('#n');
  const set = (v) => { n = v; out.textContent = n; };
  document.querySelector('#up').onclick = () => set(n + 1);
  document.querySelector('#down').onclick = () => set(n - 1);
</script>
